official_HITS_assessment.decision: Do not replace missing prompts/no_mock slice-specific templates with whole-method root templates; that silently changes the method. No invented prompts or data graphs.
official_HITS_assessment.effect: Primary HITS comparison is explicitly a reproduction result. No claim of faithfully executing the author implementation.

implementation_decisions.native_selector_mapping: All72 owners are public top-level classes. Select native metadata only after full JVM descriptor and source-body validation; no nested-owner aliases or enum exclusions are needed in this cohort.
implementation_decisions.selection_policy: All72 original exploratory methods and release versions retained, including previous weak cases and failure-prone overloads. Sample originally selected post hoc and concentrated in TextStringBuilder/Conversion; frozen before any new outcomes. No new coverage/failure based removals.
implementation_decisions.autonomous_decisions_authorized_by: User explicitly requested completion without interim clarification and allowed resource-based parallel execution.
implementation_decisions.resource_policy: At most8 generation workers and2 external measurement workers. Weighted memory reservation at24GiB:3GiB/generator and6GiB/measurement; measurement admission priority; minimum4GiB MemAvailable before admission.
implementation_decisions.primary_metrics: Exact-method common-denominator line/branch coverage including zeros; cumulative generation wall time; actual input/output/cache tokens including retries; generated Java case count, discovered/executed JUnit cases, full-unit compile success and test pass rate. No class-level metric attribution to this method cohort.
implementation_decisions.budget_comparability: All methods/tools have900s generation wall ceiling, but native strategy/search/repair budgets differ: EvoSuite search60s, Justin symbolic class20s, native ChatUniTest-family settings unchanged. Shared model field deepseek-flash,4096 max response tokens,thinking disabled; provider backend snapshot unpinned; temperatures remain native defaults.
implementation_decisions.setup_accounting: Any setup-/preflight- transport labels and invalid setup runs must be preserved separately with observed usage; unknown usage is not zero.
